title: Project architect spends judgment time finding the context around an RFI or submittal
job: Respond to RFIs/submittals/site issues with complete context, traceability and timely judgment.
trigger: RFI, submittal, site observation or change request enters the project.
surfaceComplaint: The answer is not hard; finding everything that changes the answer is.
mechanism: High-value judgment is surrounded by low-value retrieval across documents, versions and communication systems. Missing context creates rework and liability.

workflow.friction: may omit context or reference old documents

economics.painCostNote: Small retrieval waste multiplied by hundreds of items becomes meaningful professional labor and delay exposure.

buyer.roiLogic: Saving 15 minutes per CA item can recover substantial billable capacity.

distribution.acquisition: The artifact and trigger are already digital.

experiment.success: ≥30% context-retrieval time reduction with <5% material missed/incorrect refs
experiment.kill: source linking cannot reach trust threshold or integration cost dominates

claims.text: Architecture firms remain under sustained billing pressure in 2026.
The safest first wedge is verified context assembly, not autonomous professional judgment.
